title: Central-carbon FBA fluxes vs Toya 2010 (Pearson R = 0.728)
interpretation: Mean simulated central-carbon reaction fluxes (mmol/g/hr) vs Toya 2010 C13-MFA measured fluxes across 23 reactions, with error bars. Pearson R = 0.7277 (p = 8.3e-5) -- the baseline FBA solution correlates with measured E. coli central-carbon flux.
command: v2ecoli native analyses (v2ecoli/workflow/analyses/) over .pbg/runs/showcase2-baseline/sweep/showcase2_baseline parquet; rendered to PNG via vl_convert/matplotlib on the mac mini
